parameters.name: bookSearchQuery
parameters.description: The query string which will search among book titles.

parameters.name: bookIds
parameters.description: A list of object IDs pointing to book documents.

parameters.name: startDateBefore
parameters.description: The start date of the event should be before this date.

parameters.name: startDateAfter
parameters.description: The start date of the event should be after this date.

parameters.name: endDateBefore
parameters.description: The end date of the event should be before this date.

parameters.name: endDateAfter
parameters.description: The end date of the event should be after this date.

parameters.name: participantIds
parameters.description:
The ID of the participant of the event should be in this list.
This covers requestors, interested, readers etc all participants.

parameters.name: requestedByIds
parameters.description: The ID of the requestor of the event should be in this list.

parameters.name: interestedIds
parameters.description: The ID of the interested people of the event should be in this list.

parameters.name: readerIds
parameters.description: The ID of the reader of the event should be in this list.

parameters.name: leaderIds
parameters.description: The ID of the leader of the event should be in this list.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description:
Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response, or to exclude
when each entry is prefixed with `-`. Inclusion and exclusion cannot be
mixed in a single request. The `_id` field is always returned regardless.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.description:
The criterion to sort the events by.
Defaults to startDateDesc when omitted.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

get.summary:

projection and sort.
